sections.description: Interactive horizontal Bible timeline with verse pages.
sections.changelog:
1.1.0

  • Added timeline search with live event suggestions.
  • Added click-to-jump search results that slide directly to the selected timeline event.
  • Moved the search bar into the Old Testament and New Testament header area.
  • Improved main timeline card design, spacing, typography, and active states.
  • Improved verse page timeline card styling and layout.
  • Added left and right scroll arrows to the verse page timeline.
  • Added automatic centering of the matching event when opening a verse page.
  • Highlighted the related event on verse pages for better context.
  • Fixed verse page timeline cards stretching taller than needed.
  • Improved timeline navigation behavior on desktop and mobile.
  • Improved search clear button with SVG icon styling.
  • Cleaned up verse page timeline link markup to avoid unwanted paragraph and line break tags.
  • Improved overall timeline responsiveness and visual polish.
